name: MoZhu
tagline: Free BaZi chart, Chinese name generator, and AI-assisted cultural readings
description:
MoZhu turns traditional Chinese metaphysics into tools anyone can use. Type your name and get a real Chinese name that sounds like yours, with meanings, pronunciation and a free calligraphy name card. Check your 2027 horoscope by Western sign or Chinese zodiac, find auspicious dates for moving or opening a business, and cast a free BaZi (Four Pillars) chart. Charts are computed by code from open calendrical rules; interpretations are AI-generated, for entertainment and cultural reference only, and are not professional advice. Available in English, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. Free to use, with optional AI readings.

Watch out: MoZhu says charts are calculated from published calendar rules and that the interpretations are AI-generated, for entertainment only, not a prediction or advice. In-depth readings are paid per use. The free chart does not require sign-up. Checked 2026-11-14.
